Inclusion: tasks where deterministic verifier can express failure as counterexample or failing policy; Exclusion: vendor CLI variants not covered by verifier tooling. For each (baseline/adversarial) intent: (A) run LLM-only generation; (B) run LLM + binary verifier; (C) run LLM + localized verifier repair loop (up to 5 iterations). Use deterministic checks to label unsafe outputs (predefined unsafe classes: opening restricted ports, creating overly-permissive ACLs, route black-holing) in simulated topologies. Normalize verifier CPU time to a cost proxy (pre-registered normalization factor) and sum with a per-model-call cost to derive cost-per-verified-correct-change. Record queueing effects under higher volumes.
